The '''Rusty Freighter Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Entertainment Plaza]] district of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Blastfield Shipyards]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], a group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] cornered the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]] in the cantina, though he was saved by the timely arrival of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]].<ref name="TOR:JC" />
